name: Onna no Ko no Himitsu
source:
Main character has a distinctive female face. He is invited to drink tea an adviser to science department, and meeting passes without any surprise. However, overnight his body turns into a female body! It turns out that tea contained powerful drug, and antidote can be used only in a month's time. This month is going to be the time for peculiar explorations and unexpected meetings.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公有一张格外秀气的女性面孔。他受理科部顾问邀请一同喝茶，见面时并未发生任何异常。然而一夜之间，他的身体竟变成了女性！原来茶中含有一种强效药物，而解药必须等一个月后才能使用。这个月将成为一段充满奇特探索与意外邂逅的时光。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
